title: wai adapter: re-import not idempotent - kaya.ledger.id_reuse on re-observed records (absorbs content-hash dedup seam)
description:
Re-running `kaya import wai` on an unchanged or edited .wai tree fails with kaya.ledger.id_reuse instead of skipping or correcting, breaking `just record-capture` replay idempotency.

Mechanism: the wai event id hashes only (project, artifact timestamp, path, kind) — src/adapters/wai.rs:174-177 and event_id() at :362-365; content-derived attributes (title, title_digest) sit outside the id (add_capture_attributes). An edited record keeping its declared timestamp therefore derives an existing id with different bytes; the ledger refuses (ids are never reused, suggests a correction event naming data.supersedes) and the adapter has no skip-if-known or supersede path.

Observed 2026-11-24 on a07ac35: first failed run still appended 2 events before the collision aborted the rest (wai source count 417 -> 419) — the atomicity claimed in the adapter header (src/adapters/wai.rs:6) does not hold across the append stream.

Absorbs the "incremental import dedup by content hash" seam named in openspec/changes/archive/2026-11-22-add-agent-session-capture/proposal.md:145-147, which requires an append-then-reimport test.
acceptance_criteria: Meter: append-then-reimport test - import wai twice on an unchanged tree; second run appends nothing and exits 0. Edited-record case (same declared timestamp, changed bytes) yields a correction/supersede path, never kaya.ledger.id_reuse. just record-capture runs twice consecutively. Anti-goals: no kaya.event/v0 schema change; no edit-in-place of stored lines; ledger stays append-only. New/reshaped files carry Purpose/Responsibilities/Rationale headers.
